comparisons.peer_summary: The Company's purchase commitments primarily include obligations to purchase wafers and substrates from third parties, as well as future payments for software, technology licenses, and IP licenses.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Micron disclose their primary components of long-term purchase commitments. Micron identifies property, plant, and equipment (PP&E) and goods/services with fixed quantities as the primary drivers of its $6.7 billion obligation. Similarly, AMD identifies obligations to purchase wafers and substrates (essential goods) and software/IP licenses as the composition of its purchase commitments.
